chunks: From him, from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb, who said:
I asked him about a man who performed the Zuhr prayer when the sun had declined. He said: There is no problem with it.

key_terms.الشَّمْسُ: the sun; used to define the prayer time
key_terms.الظُّهْرَ: the Zuhr prayer, the midday obligatory salat
key_terms.حِينَ: when; indicating the relevant time circumstance
key_terms.رَجُلٍ: a man; the person about whom the legal ruling is being asked
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: no harm; an expression indicating permissibility

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray Zuhr when the sun begins to decline?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the time of salat al-Zuhr. It indicates that performing the Zuhr prayer at the time of the sun’s decline is permissible and unobjectionable.
